handback.title: A role can run on Kimi Code CLI
handback.summary: Any role named on a Kimi subscription runs in Kimi Code CLI, signed in from the stored sign-in.
handback.user_story: The owner moves any role to Kimi by naming a Kimi subscription for it, and spends Kimi's credit.

acceptance_criteria.text: A role on a Kimi subscription starts Kimi Code CLI with the Kimi model the settings file names.
acceptance_criteria.words: Kimi models in Kimi Code CLI

edge_cases.case: Kimi fails: the run fails with Kimi's own exit code.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Kimi run puts the stored sign-in back in place before Kimi starts, so no one signs in again.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Runs always start on a fresh machine with one stored sign-in, the case its test covers.
